translations.web: except that the Holy Spirit testifies in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions wait for me.
translations.bsb: I only know that in town after town the Holy Spirit warns me that chains and afflictions await me.
translations.kjv: Save that the Holy Ghost witnesseth in every city, saying that bonds and afflictions abide me.
